def diff():
    b=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(63) for j in range(64) if b[i][j]!=c[i][j])
def gb(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']!=7 and n['pixels']>1:
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; out['g']=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']!=7 and n['pixels']>1:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; out['y']=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
    return out
# current green 2, yellow 8 -> want green 8, yellow 2
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':45}]*3 + [{'action':'MOUSE','row':38,'col':24}]*2)
print("after:",gb(current_frame),"score",r.get('score'),"lvl",r.get('level_completed'),"state",r.get('state'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
